judgement.title: APM PMS Q&A SOP: the session run on Monday 26 October 2026 on Friday 23 October's closing prices, for your session on Tuesday 27 October
judgement.heading: Hexatronic | Middle Innings Core Investment, no sell signal | 4.95% of the fund's capital in 4 tranches
judgement.markdown:
- **Industry:** Hexatronic is in Technology. Technology's Industry RS was 86 at the Friday 23 October reading (86 four weeks earlier)
- **Sector:** Hexatronic is in Hardware. Hardware's Sector RS was 57 at the 30 September month-end (63 at the August month-end); on Friday's daily reading it was 31
  - Hexatronic's sector's other companies, with their daily Stock RS: Nokia (66), Ericsson (69), Logitech International (72), HMS Networks (47), Kitron (48), Kontron (15), and 11 more
- **Cohort:** Hexatronic is in Telecommunications network and fibre equipment. The cohort's relative strength was 72 on Friday's daily reading (75 four weeks earlier). Hexatronic's cohort's other companies: Nokia (66), Ericsson (69), Adtran Networks (38)
- **Hexatronic's charts are on Hexatronic's page on the PMS Per-stock Dashboard:** https://vfhqi.github.io/ratings/pms/holding.html?t=HTRO-SE

**What is going on, and why it matters**
- **The price move, by beta:** over five sessions Hexatronic's shares rose about 5% while the Stoxx Europe 600 fell about 1.4%; Hexatronic's beta of 1.35 implies a fall of about 2%, so Hexatronic's own move was about +7%, within its usual size (0.8 times)
  - The dated news: Hexatronic's third-quarter results on Thursday 22 October: sales SEK 2,498 million against a consensus of SEK 2,256 million (+11%), organic growth 17%, adjusted operating profit SEK 281 million against SEK 233 million (+21%) and a margin of 11.3%
- **The results against the memo's own test:** the memo asked for Fiber Solutions organic growth above 5% and an adjusted gross margin above 38%; the quarter delivered 13% and 39.8%
  - Two cautions from the same report: management expects Data Center activity to normalise in the fourth quarter, and glass fibre and connectors are starting to restrict growth, with price rises being tested; the Group finance director also moves to run Fiber Solutions on 1 November with no named successor
- **The sector:** Hexatronic's sector's companies fell about 3% over the same five sessions, so the Hexatronic rise is Hexatronic's own, on the results
- **The analysts:** for Hexatronic, Net Upgrade Breadth, sales estimates was +20% and Net Upgrade Breadth, target prices 0% at the 30 September month-end, before the results; Hexatronic's Sell-side Momentum rating rose from B to A this week

**What it means for the position**
- **Holding:** hold Hexatronic; no Sell Criterion is met and Hexatronic passes every test of the Pool of Stocks Eligible for Middle Innings Portfolio Selection
- **Selling:** Hexatronic's nearest trigger is the relative 52W high trigger at about SEK 37.37, about 11% below Friday's close of SEK 42.13; a Hexatronic sale is unlikely this quarter
- **Adding:** the add rule allows 1.67% more, and Hexatronic now meets your Broadening test (Sell-side Momentum up, a results beat, a rising 50-day moving average); Hexatronic is about 6% above that rising average (SEK 39.92), so your retest test is not met
  - *My view: wait one session for the Investment Analyst's reading of the results;* the price is about 13% above the memo's buying price (about SEK 37), and the memo has not yet been re-rated on the results (decision 4 in section 7 gives you the alternative of adding now)

**What we could lose:** about 0.56% of the fund's capital, if Hexatronic's price falls to its relative 52W high trigger

**Experiment: which stocks Hexatronic's own moves have tracked** (last 3 and 6 months)
- **Mycronic** (same country of listing): 0.62 and 0.55, strong
- **Atlas Copco** (same country of listing): 0.46 and 0.30, moderate
- **Munters** (same country of listing): 0.43 and 0.36, moderate
- **Nokia** (same sector and cohort): 0.40 and 0.36, moderate
- **My reading:** Hexatronic's own moves track Swedish industrial technology, not fibre peers, so look at Mycronic first to tell a Swedish growth sell-off from a Hexatronic problem

**The Investment Analyst's memo on Hexatronic (1 October, at SEK 39.74; digest of 22 September), with the results note of 22 October**
- **Decided:** the memo on Hexatronic is neutral and parks the case on the return, not on the quality gate; the Investment Analyst's results note of 22 October says the results "strengthen the existing case materially", without yet changing the ratings
- **Must happen:** the memo's progress test (Fiber Solutions organic growth above 5% with an adjusted gross margin above 38%) is met; the results note's next test is whether the gross margin holds in the fourth quarter as Data Center normalises and fibre costs rise
- **Main risk:** the third-quarter margin was helped by mix and timing, so the real test of price pass-through is the next two quarters
- **Expected return (the Modal return):** below our bar of 20% a year at SEK 39.74 in the memo; the memo's numbers clear the bar below about SEK 37, about 12% below Friday's close, until the Investment Analyst re-rates the case
- **Next test:** the Investment Analyst's re-reading of the results, then the fourth-quarter report on 4 February 2027

**My judgement:** bullish on holding Hexatronic, medium conviction
- The results answered the question the memo parked the case on, and Hexatronic is the only holding whose top-down readings improved this week; the price has run ahead of the memo, so the add waits a week, not the case
- **Counter-case:** the beat came largely from a Data Center quarter that management says will not repeat, and Hexatronic's first base is about 33% deep on Minervini's count, past our caution line (Addendum D)

**What would change my view:** the Investment Analyst raising the memo's buying price above about SEK 42; a fall back towards the rising 50-day moving average (about SEK 40), which would meet your retest test

items.criterion: MA SLs: each tranche's MA less 2%, information only for a Middle Innings Core Investment

bullets.text: Hexatronic is a Middle Innings Core Investment, so its MA SLs sell nothing; its six Sell Criteria decide the sale.
Hexatronic's MA SL exits were confirmed for tranche 1 on 8-Jul and tranches 3 and 4 on 15-Sep, but Hexatronic has since closed back above those stops.
On 27-Oct all four Hexatronic MA SL stops sat 12.1% to 12.9% below the 44.68 close, so one fall of about 13% would breach all four at once.

items.criterion: Relative price more than 25% below its 52W high, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: Hexatronic's relative price was 11.7% below its 52W high on 27-Oct, the nearest of Hexatronic's Sell Criteria to its line of 25%.
At a flat market, Hexatronic's relative price gives a sell signal at the Fri 30-Oct month-end only on a close below 37.97, 15.0% below the 27-Oct close.
A sell signal from Hexatronic's relative price against its 52W high would sell the whole Hexatronic holding at the Tue 3-Nov session, as Hexatronic is not under your one-off in/out link.

items.criterion: Sector RS below 50 with Stock RS below 70, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: Hardware's Sector RS was 25 on 27-Oct, below 50, but Hexatronic's Stock RS of 98 is far above 70.
Hexatronic's Stock RS has been 85 or above at every reading since 13-Mar-2026, and would need to fall 29 points by Fri 30-Oct for a Sector RS sell signal.
After the Fri 30-Oct month-end, Hexatronic's Sector RS test is next read at the 30-Nov month-end.

items.criterion: A tranche 30% below its highest close since purchase, with Stock RS below 70

bullets.text: No sell signal: Hexatronic's 30% fall levels are 31.79 for tranche 1 and 31.28 for tranches 2 to 4, 28.8% and 30.0% below the 27-Oct close.
Only a repeat of Hexatronic's 31.3% June fall would reach Hexatronic's 30% fall levels, and Hexatronic's Stock RS of 98 is far above 70.

items.criterion: Stock RS below 50 with revenue or PT Net Upgrade Breadth below zero, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: Hexatronic's Stock RS is 98 and its revenue and PT Net Upgrade Breadth are both +100% on 27-Oct, 4 of 4 analysts raising.
With only four analysts covering Hexatronic, each is a quarter of Hexatronic's Net Upgrade Breadth, and part of the 23-Oct jump may be one analyst leaving.

A technology sell-off would hit Hexatronic's SP, testing Hexatronic's relative-price 52W-high level and MA SLs, long before Technology's Industry RS fell below 30.

adds.criterion: The rules: no sell signal from the six Sell Criteria

bullets.text: No sell signal from any of the six Sell Criteria for Hexatronic at its latest readings, so the Sell Criteria do not block an add to Hexatronic.
Hexatronic's Stock RS was 94 and its relative price 20.8% below its 52W high at 30-Sep, and Technology's Industry RS was 86 at 23-Oct.
A sell signal at the Fri 30-Oct readings would block adds to Hexatronic, the nearest being Hexatronic's relative price against its 52W high.

adds.criterion: The rules: room below the holding's limit

bullets.text: Hexatronic is 4.95% of capital against the 6.68% limit for a Middle Innings Core Investment, leaving 1.73% of room, a little more than one 1.67% tranche.
The 6.68% limit only stops adds to Hexatronic above that size and never forces a sale of Hexatronic.
One 1.67% tranche would take Hexatronic to 6.62% of capital, leaving no room for a further tranche.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a positive retest of a rising MA

bullets.text: Hexatronic's October pullback closed 0.7% to 1.6% below its rising 150D MA on 19 to 21-Oct, then closed back above that MA on 22-Oct.
The same Hexatronic pullback closed 2.2% to 3.0% below its rising 50D MA and up to 5.1% below its rising 20D MA, failing your retest test at those two MAs.
Whether Hexatronic's 22-Oct rebound counts as a positive retest, given its hold at the rising 150D MA and its breaks of the rising 20D and 50D MAs, is your ruling.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a broadening of the case (momentum rising in guidance, sell-side estimates, technicals or peers)

bullets.text: Hexatronic's sell-side estimates are rising: consensus FY2027 EPS rose 10.3% from 30-Sep to 28-Oct, and every Hexatronic Net Upgrade Breadth reading was +100.0% on 28-Oct.
Hexatronic's technicals are strong, with Stock RS 97 at the 23-Oct reading, while Hexatronic's cohort peers are mixed and Hexatronic's guidance was not checked for this page.
Your notes hold nothing on Hexatronic since 22-Sep-2026, when you wrote that Hexatronic is "more likely to break out upwards than downwards IMHO".
Your 22-Sep-2026 note ("Moving averages are compressing at this flat trading band level - rising 150D and 200D MA") is constructive on Hexatronic's chart but silent on adding.
